recent_en: Aemulus recently secured about RM15.8 million in data centre and AI test system orders from a Singapore customer and entered a joint development agreement with Samsung Electro-Mechanics. Latest quarterly revenue rose 42.8% year-on-year and net profit turned positive.
notable_en: Secured about RM15.8 million in data centre and AI test system orders from a Singapore customer.
Entered a joint development agreement with Samsung Electro-Mechanics.
Latest quarterly revenue rose 42.8% year-on-year and net profit turned positive.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was MYR 27.216 million, up 21.7% QoQ and 42.8% YoY; net profit was MYR 516,000 with a 1.9% net margin, turning positive from -3.1% in the prior quarter, and net profit rose 2050.0% YoY.
